text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Takarazuka Kinen was not 
one of the four heavily favored Umamusume. 
—None of them emerged victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, this was also proof that T.M. 
Opera O was not invincible—Admire Vega and 
Narita Top Road both vowed absolute 
victory for their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O is visibly shaken. Seeing 
this, Meisho Doto puts a certain idea into 
action—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, having carved out her own future, 
Narita Top Road advances to the first race 
of the Autumn GⅠ campaign—the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
